page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Below it, one table with a header line and two sections separated by a rule, each row with cells for Indiction, Year of Julian Period, Dominical letters, Golden number, Epact-type numbers, Feast date (Nabon.), and Christian year. Below the table at right, one catchword.

main_text.l: Indict. | Anni Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi.

page.notes: Small dots and marks beside 1497, 2223, and before 1478 are printer's or ink marks, not text. The Christi column reads 1452 to 1482 in the first and second sections. The header word "Christi" is partly rubbed on the scan; read as "Christi" with the final letter doubtful. The catchword "1·1528" is printed at lower right outside the table.
